tools.name: chat
tools.description: Ask an LLM a question. Returns a text completion.

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: Resolve a DNS record (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS).

tools.name: crypto_price
tools.description: Current USD prices for one or more coins (CoinGecko ids, comma-separated).

tools.name: base_gas
tools.description: Current Base L2 gas price in wei and gwei.

tools.name: wikipedia_summary
tools.description: Short summary of a Wikipedia article by title.

tools.name: brief
tools.description: Composite analyst brief: gathers live market facts (crypto prices, DeFi yields, Base block height) and returns an LLM-written brief with headline, key points, and a take. Requires a Bearer key.

tools.name: web_read
tools.description: Fetch any public web page and return its main readable content as clean Markdown (nav/ads stripped) for RAG and agent pipelines.

tools.name: ofac_sanctions_search
tools.description: Search the US Treasury OFAC SDN sanctions list by entity name (KYB/AML screening).

tools.name: fda_lookup
tools.description: US FDA open data: drug adverse events, drug/food/device recalls, drug labels.

tools.name: kyb_screening
tools.description: Composite counterparty due-diligence: OFAC SDN sanctions screening + GLEIF LEI + SEC EDGAR in one call. Requires a Bearer key.

tools.name: enrich
tools.description: One-call domain/company enrichment: DNS A records + certificate transparency names + GLEIF LEI + OFAC SDN + web snapshot, with an aggregate risk_summary. Requires a Bearer key.

tools.name: fair_draw
tools.description: Provably-fair random integer from a committed seed (commit-reveal). Use for verifiable winner selection, raffles and allocations. Reveal the seed afterwards so anyone can reproduce the result.

tools.name: fair_pick
tools.description: Provably-fair selection of one winner from a list of candidates. For bounties with a single prize.
